title: Facebook: The Trillion Dollar Listing - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 15]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, we will be diving into Facebook.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be diving into Facebook. A business that requires little introduction, Facebook was launched in 2004 from Marc Zuckerberg’s Harvard dorm room. Zuckerberg has since grown Facebook into the largest social network in the world and continues to operate the business today.

key_points.text: To break down Facebook, I am first joined by Robert Cantwell, founder and CIO of Upholdings.
Rob’s unique background makes him an ideal person to speak on Facebook.
Rob shared a dorm with Zuckerberg, went on to work at Elevation Partners, a large private investor in Facebook.
